dailyHeadline: CAAAAM CHASES 11-0 AS WITNESS-PROTECTION CARLACOTE PULLS OFF HIGHWAY ROBBERY FOR NICO COLLINS
dailySubhead: Week 11 kicks off on Route 138 with 10-0 Caaaam leading CarlaCote 85.6-62.4, while 1-9 CerealStroke threatens to hand trade-addict ELord11 a sixth straight loss.
tickerTape: LIVE WEEK 11: Undefeated Caaaam (10-0) leads CarlaCote 85.6 to 62.4 as Caaaam eyes an 11th straight win.
UPSET ALERT: 1-9 CerealStroke ($0 FAAB all year) leads 3-7 ELord11 78.1 to 60.22 after dropping 164.18 on owenriddell in Week 10.
WEEK 10 HEARTBREAKER: Shipoopiehole edged Tylero0 152.56-152.14, only to faceplant with 24.1 points so far in Week 11 vs. JewsInParis (78.18).
TRADE SHOCKWAVE: CarlaCote stepped out of witness protection to acquire Nico Collins & Blake Corum from PrayingGrantis for just Matthew Golden.
WAIVER BURN: Shipoopiehole spent $5 FAAB on Seth McGowan in Week 10, then immediately dropped him for Chig Okonkwo on Friday.
KINGSTON BASEMENT: owenriddell sits on a 7-game losing streak after scoring 86.52 in Week 10 and trails Tylero0 87.1 to 45.3 today.

roasts.headline: CarlaCote Emerges From Witness Protection to Fleece Superteam Architect PrayingGrantis for Nico Collins
roasts.body:
Stop the buses on Upper College Road—we have an actual sighting of CarlaCote in the Sleeper transaction log, and it looks like a daylight mugging. In Week 10, the league's most elusive 6-4 manager traded Matthew Golden straight up to PrayingGrantis in exchange for Nico Collins AND Blake Corum. PrayingGrantis leads the entire Rhody league with 1,532.72 points for and normally builds unstoppable superteams, so did CarlaCote threaten to reveal where the bodies are buried behind Butterfield Dining Hall, or did Grantis accidentally hit accept while trying to set a lineup?

Meanwhile, someone needs to check ELord11's pulse and confiscate their phone before Sunday kickoff. On a brutal five-game losing streak at 3-7, ELord11 has turned the trade block into a spinning roulette wheel at Twin River. In Week 9 alone, ELord11 shipped off Puka Nacua to league fleece-artist Tylero0 for Drake London and Garrett Wilson, right after trading Josh Jacobs and Jaylen Waddle to Unanswered for A.J. Brown. All that wheeling and dealing, and ELord11 is still losing to a CerealStroke squad that hasn't spent a single dollar of FAAB since August.

roasts.headline: CerealStroke's Heater Continues vs. ELord11 While Shipoopiehole Crashes Back to Earth After 0.42-Point Miracle
roasts.body:
Pour yourself a lukewarm coffee from the Emporium and behold the chaos on the Week 11 scoreboard. Fresh off breaking a nine-game drought with a massive 164.18-point demolition of owenriddell in Week 10, 1-9 CerealStroke is back at it—currently leading ELord11 78.1 to 60.22. Having zero FAAB spent and 214.44 points rotting on the bench all season hasn't stopped CerealStroke from turning ELord11's playoff hopes into a smoking crater on the Keaney Gym parking lot.

Elsewhere, Shipoopiehole is experiencing the sharpest hangover in Kingston history. Just seven days ago, Shipoopiehole pulled off the miracle of the season, edging Tylero0 by 0.42 points in a 152.56-152.14 thriller. Today? Shipoopiehole's roster has faceplanted to 24.1 points against JewsInParis (78.18), who desperately needs this rebound after back-to-back losses. And in the marquee matchup at the Ryan Center, 10-0 Caaaam holds an early 85.6-62.4 lead over CarlaCote, while Tylero0 (87.1) is busy burying 7-straight-loser owenriddell (45.3).

roasts.headline: Shipoopiehole's $5 Seth McGowan Rental, $0 CerealStroke Magic, and ELord11's Desperation $1 Defense Bid
roasts.body:
If you ever wanted proof that FAAB budgets in Rhody are treated like Monopoly money at a frat basement poker game, look no further than Shipoopiehole's Week 10-to-11 transaction trail. On Tuesday at 3:07 AM, Shipoopiehole enthusiastically burned $5 of remaining FAAB to win Seth McGowan off waivers. By Friday afternoon at 4:09 PM, McGowan was kicked to the curb for free-agent tight end Chig Okonkwo. That's $5 burned for zero snaps—though at least it wasn't $50 in Week 1 on a defense like our 10-0 commissioner-in-spirit Caaaam.

Speaking of defenses, owenriddell quietly dropped the Jacksonville Jaguars on Thursday night to pivot to the Lions, only for ELord11 to rush in Saturday night and drop a $1 FAAB bid on Jacksonville. Meanwhile, CerealStroke continues to mock the entire waiver system, scooping up Chimere Dike and the 49ers defense for $0 while keeping all $100 FAAB untouched in a glass case. Not to be outdone in bizarre roster management, JewsInParis—who still carries the stain of the Drake London-for-Jordan Mason trade—dumped Jordan Addison for Elic Ayomanor on Wednesday. Someone tell Paris that Tennessee pass-catchers aren't going to fix a two-game skid.

roasts.headline: Caaaam's Cakewalk Schedule Fuels 10-0 Run as Three 7-3 Sharks Battle for the Bye
roasts.body:
Let's look closely at the 10-0 juggernaut sitting atop the Rhody standings. Yes, Caaaam has racked up 1,510.16 points for and is currently out of FAAB after spending every last dime, and yes, Caaaam probably already has a 3,000-word newsletter drafted celebrating an 11-0 start. However, let's check the points-against column: 1,225.56 PA, the lowest in the entire league by over 30 points. While Shipoopiehole has suffered through a league-worst 1,508.6 points against, Caaaam has enjoyed a velvet-rope schedule smoother than fresh Narragansett pavement.

Right behind the undefeated kingpin, a three-way dogfight at 7-3 is brewing for that crucial second seed. PrayingGrantis leads the entire league in scoring at 1,532.72 PF (despite leaving a league-high 232.22 points on the bench) and holds a comfortable 60.84-33.2 lead over 5-5 Unanswered today. Tylero0 (1,475.48 PF) and JewsInParis (1,450.16 PF) are right on Grantis's heels, while 6-4 CarlaCote—who has somehow spent only $7 of FAAB all season—is quietly lurking in fifth place with Nico Collins newly strapped to the hood.

powerRankings.blurb: Sitting at 10-0 with 1,510.16 PF and a cozy 1,225.56 PA, Caaaam is already leading CarlaCote 85.6-62.4 in Week 11 with $0 FAAB left in the tank. Even after wasting 50 FAAB on a defense in Week 1 and dropping kicker Jason Sanders this week, nobody in Kingston can stop the newsletter machine.

The 7-3 squad leads the entire league with 1,532.72 PF after dropping 176.14 on JewsInParis last week and holds a 60.84-33.2 lead over Unanswered today. Still, leaving a league-high 232.22 points on the bench and donating Nico Collins for Matthew Golden raises serious questions about Grantis's Sunday sobriety.

Tylero0 suffered a brutal 0.42-point loss to Shipoopiehole in Week 10 (152.56-152.14) to fall to 7-3, though the Week 9 heist of Puka Nacua keeps the ceiling sky-high. Already cruising 87.1-45.3 over owenriddell after grabbing Mark Andrews and Jacory Croskey-Merritt, Tylero0 is back on track.

Quietly sitting at 6-4 on a two-game win streak with just $7 FAAB spent, CarlaCote dropped 167.26 in Week 10 and somehow robbed PrayingGrantis for Nico Collins and Blake Corum. Currently trailing Caaaam 85.6-62.4, the witness-protection magic is facing its toughest test yet.

Two straight losses have dropped JewsInParis to 7-3 with a hefty 1,414.74 PA, and replacing Jordan Addison with Elic Ayomanor screams midseason desperation. Luckily, facing a lifeless 24.1-point Shipoopiehole squad while already at 78.18 points should stop the bleeding.

Sitting squarely at .500 (5-5, 1,294.5 PF) with all $100 FAAB already burned, Unanswered followed up a 158.32-123.66 loss to Caaaam by falling behind PrayingGrantis 60.84-33.2 today. That Week 9 trade for Josh Jacobs and Jaylen Waddle needs to start paying rent immediately.

Five straight losses have sunk ELord11 to 3-7 (1,289.3 PF) despite making more trades than a Wall Street day trader on espresso. Trailing 1-9 CerealStroke 78.1-60.22 after spending $1 FAAB on Jacksonville's defense Saturday night is pure rock bottom.

Credit where it's due: beating Tylero0 152.56-152.14 in Week 10 snapped a brutal stretch against a league-worst 1,508.6 PA. Sadly, being stuck at 2-8, burning $5 FAAB on a two-day Seth McGowan rental, and putting up 24.1 points so far today puts the fire right back in the dumpster.

Still in last place at 1-9 with a league-low 1,056.8 PF, CerealStroke finally got off the schneid by crushing owenriddell 164.18-86.52 and currently leads ELord11 78.1-60.22. Refusing to spend a single dollar of FAAB while leaving 214.44 points on the bench is truly performance art.

Seven consecutive losses, 2-8 overall, 1,155.18 PF, and an embarrassing 86.52-point showing that handed CerealStroke its first win of 2026. Trailing Tylero0 87.1-45.3 in Week 11, even swapping Jacksonville's defense for Detroit can't save this sinking ship.

tradeGrades.summary: CarlaCote received Nico Collins (WR - HOU) & Blake Corum (RB - LAR); PrayingGrantis received Matthew Golden (WR - GB)
tradeGrades.verdict: CarlaCote stepped out of witness protection and walked away with an alpha WR1 plus a handcuff RB for Matthew Golden. Unless PrayingGrantis knows something the rest of the NFL doesn't, this is an outright robbery.

tradeGrades.summary: Tylero0 received Puka Nacua (WR - LAR); ELord11 received Drake London (WR - ATL) & Garrett Wilson (WR - NYJ)
tradeGrades.verdict: Tylero0's infamous trade-fleece streak claims another victim, turning two volatile receivers into the Rams' undisputed target monster. Meanwhile, ELord11 keeps shuffling deck chairs on a 3-7 Titanic.

tradeGrades.summary: Unanswered received Josh Jacobs (RB - GB) & Jaylen Waddle (WR - DEN); ELord11 received A.J. Brown (WR - NE)
tradeGrades.verdict: Unanswered landed a workhorse running back and a viable starter for a single wide receiver, giving the 5-5 squad real depth. ELord11 paid a steep two-for-one premium just to keep riding a five-game losing streak.

tradeGrades.summary: ELord11 received Trey McBride (TE - ARI) & Emeka Egbuka (WR - TB); owenriddell received Kyren Williams (RB - LAR), Omarion Hampton (RB - LAC) & Tyler Warren (TE - IND)
tradeGrades.verdict: On paper, owenriddell got a haul of running backs and ELord11 got an elite tight end, yet since Week 7 these two managers have combined for a 5-game and 7-game losing streak. A rare blockbuster that managed to sink both franchises.
